from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialResult(BaseModel):
    """One company's quarterly financial results from their 10-Q filing"""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name as reported in the filing")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period in YYYY-MM format")
    total_revenue: float | None = Field(description="Total revenues/net sales amount")
    net_income: float | None = Field(description="Consolidated net income amount; negative if loss")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_financial_results: list[CompanyFinancialResult]
